name: Alien Xenocide
storyline:
Space aliens and mediocre delivery girls Blunt and Kif work for XENO XPRESS, an intergalactic delivery service owned by their boss, Eugene Hash. After goofing off on the job for so long, the lovebirds are presented one last chance to keep their jobs: a delivery of a cardboard cutout to “Mayor Roogan” on planet Goobtopia. What they don’t know however, is the entire planet is swarming with infectious GOOBERS, a highly infectious race of dorky aliens. They'll stop at nothing to protect not only the package, nor their lives -- but their jobs. Priorities.

Follow the girls on their journey through Goobtopia's 7 unique worlds, filled to the brim with exciting gimmicks, intense bossfights, and witty humor. Reminiscent to old arcade games, levels are single screen yet fully captivating with newly introduced strategies, events, designs, and most notably: different goobers EACH stage!

Throughout your journey, you'll encounter over 40 different Goobers, and that ain't including the incredible bossfights! Each one is designed to bring a new way to blast through 'em, as well as a design to get a chuckle out of your system.
summary: Alien Xenocide is an action-packed, retro platformer featuring explosive gameplay, arcade callbacks with modern twists, and a sense of humor. Fast paced platforming, aliens, and a babelicious babe — what's not to like?
